description: Which of the twelve New Leaf properties in Twin Falls has a room free tonight or on particular nights. Checks all twelve live for the requested dates. The published availability feeds carry CAPACITY, not vacancy, and say nothing about which nights are taken. With no dates it answers for tonight and says so. It applies each property's live minimum stay: a single or a double can be one night, subject to availability, and a studio is 7 nights or more. For a stay under a week with a room free it gives the nightly rates. A stay over 30 nights is refused before anything else: every stay is capped at 30 days.

checkin.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to tonight when dates are absent.

checkout.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. The night before this is the last night slept.

roomtype.description: Optional filter: single, double or studio.
